extDesc.message: Reads the clipboard and types it into the focused field key by key, with real keyboard events.

cmdDesc.message: Type the clipboard contents into the focused field

errNoUrl.message: the tab doesn't expose its URL; can't operate

errWinUnfocused.message: the window doesn't have focus — click the page and run it again

errInject.message: this page doesn't allow script injection (chrome://, Web Store…) — nothing to type

errNotEditable.message: the focused element is not editable ($WHY$). Click into the field and retry.

runCdp.message: typing · CDP method (chrome.debugger) · Esc or Alt+Shift+V to cancel

runJs.message: typing · JS events method (isTrusted=false; see README) · Esc to cancel

okMatch.message: done · $METHOD$ method · the field matches the clipboard

okInserted.message: done · $METHOD$ method · the text was inserted (the field already had text)

dif.message: finished ($METHOD$ method) but the field does NOT match the clipboard$DETAIL$. @mention typeahead, autocorrect or maxLength?

okUnverified.message: finished ($METHOD$ method); couldn't read the field to verify ($ERR$)

reasonDetach.message: the debugger was detached (did you close the infobar or the tab?)

whyNotEditable.message: the focus is not on an input/textarea/contenteditable

offscreenReason.message: Read the clipboard text to type it into the focused field
